title: PreviewReady
description: Terminal reply to preview: the file's details and its thumbnail. Codes and data only; the UI words the type, size, date and outcome. The engine decides which thumbnail a file gets: the image itself for PNG, JPG/JPEG, GIF, WEBP and BMP up to 10 MB, the first 2,048 bytes as text for text and Markdown files, and a page shape for everything else and for any file it couldn't read (then with outcomeCode).

outcomeCode.title: ReadOutcomeCode
outcomeCode.description: Why the file has no image or text thumbnail, when that needs saying: storedOnlyInOneDrive (online only: never opened), tooLarge (an image over the size cap) or cannotRead (missing, access denied, in use, or not read in time). Only with a page thumbnail. Absent otherwise; listed in codes.json readOutcomeCodes.

path.description: The file's full display path, in on-disk casing when the engine could look it up.

size.description: Size in bytes; null when the file couldn't be looked up.

modified.description: Same as folderListing's ModifiedTime: ISO 8601 with the local offset; null when unknown.

imageThumbnail.title: ImageThumbnail
imageThumbnail.description: The image file's bytes, unchanged (never decoded or resized), as base64.

textThumbnail.title: TextThumbnail
textThumbnail.description: The file's first 2,048 bytes as text: UTF-8 (a BOM dropped) or UTF-16 by its BOM, invalid bytes replaced, a character cut off at the end dropped.

pageThumbnail.title: PageThumbnail
pageThumbnail.description: No content: the UI draws a page with the file's type icon and extension.
